todos.description: Remove fabricated entries from data/superconductor_database.json: delete the 'TestMaterial' entry and entries with DOIs containing 'XXXXX' (e.g., Nd0.8Sr0.2NiO2 with doi XXXXX, HgBa2Ca2Cu3O8 with doi XXXXX); review and merge duplicate entries for identical compounds (e.g., YH6, CaH6, Li2MgH16, C-S-H, La3Ni2O7 appear 3-5 times each with different Tc/pressure values); consolidate the identical Tc series for rare-earth H9 compounds (PrH9..LuH9 all at 100K/100GPa) into a single representative entry per unique compound.

Fix scripts/predict_tc.py: (1) consolidate 7+ duplicate definitions of predict_tc, 4+ of train_model, 2+ of main into single canonical versions; (2) change module-level load_database() default path from 'superconductor_data.json' to 'data/superconductor_database.json'; (3) move module-level TRAINING_DATA = load_database() call inside function bodies (lazy) to prevent import-time crash; (4) keep only one canonical predict_tc with proper pressure-dependent McMillan-Allen-Dynes formula.

Fix run_pipeline.py: remove 7+ references to non-existent module 'output_ranked' (importlib.import_module('output_ranked') at lines 301, 3903, and direct imports at line 6314); replace calls to .run() on imported modules (query_database, generate_candidates, predict_tc, output_ranked) which don't define a run() function - verified by grep for 'def run(' returning zero matches in scripts/; either call the actual entry-point functions or remove the pipeline orchestration logic since the modules only expose main() entry points.

Fix tests/test_api_client.py: test_fetch_materials_project_returns_dict asserts isinstance(result, dict) and 'data' in result, but fetch_materials_project() returns data.get('response', []) which is a list, not a dict. Change the assertion to isinstance(result, list) and remove the 'data' in result check, or match the actual return type.

Update docs/proposed_chemistry_physics.md to include 2024-2026 breakthroughs: LaSc2H24 room-temperature superconductor (Nature Phys 2024), zentropy theory for high-Tc design, twisted WSe2 moiré superconductivity, H3S tunneling gap anomaly, pressure-quenched Hg-1223 near-ambient retention, Li-Na-H clathrate predictions, and AI causal discovery for superconductor screening. Current document only covers literature up to ~2023.

Expand requirements.txt from only 6 packages to include all packages actually imported across the project: torch, torch-geometric, stable-baselines3, fastapi, streamlit, GPy, uvicorn, slowapi, prometheus_client, cryptography, pulp, simpy, SALib, networkx, scikit-optimize, mp-api-client, aiohttp, pymatgen, ase, joblib, pandas, plotly, websockets, apscheduler, dowhy, openai, pymc3, shap, gym, and any others missing. The current file only lists pytest, pytest-cov, numpy, scipy, matplotlib, pandas.
